title: Companies Act, 2013 — Section 378B (Objects of Producer Company)

content.overview: The objects of a Producer Company shall relate to all or any of the matters listed in section 378B(1), including production, harvesting, procurement, grading, pooling, handling, marketing, selling and export of the primary produce of its Members (or import of goods or services for their benefit), processing, supply of machinery or consumables mainly to Members, education on mutual assistance, technical services, power generation and land/water revitalisation, insurance, mutuality techniques, welfare measures, and ancillary activities promoting mutual assistance.
content.glance: Statutory list of permitted objects for a Producer Company; activities must relate primarily to Members' primary produce.
content.study: Section 378B confines the objects of a Producer Company to the enumerated list. The company may carry on the activities itself or through another institution. An object outside the list is not authorised by this section. The memorandum must state objects consistent with this provision.

sections.heading: Rule
sections.body: Objects of a Producer Company are limited to the statutory list in s. 378B(1) relating to primary produce of Members and mutual-assistance activities.

examples.title: Illustration — s. 378B
examples.body: A Producer Company whose objects are confined to pooling, processing and marketing of Members' agricultural produce complies with s. 378B.

hypotheticals.question: What is the core effect of s. 378B?
hypotheticals.analysis: It fixes the permitted objects of a Producer Company and links incorporation under s. 378C to those objects.

misconceptions.trap: Treating any commercial object as available to a Producer Company.
misconceptions.correction: Only the objects listed in s. 378B are authorised.

questionsAndAnswers.question: How should s. 378B be analysed?
questionsAndAnswers.answer: I. State the statutory objects. II. Check memorandum consistency. III. Conclude.
